title: Efficient GPU Retrieval for Semantic Search
abstract: arXiv:2608.28968v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Semantic Search on LinkedIn must retrieve relevant profiles from a corpus of hundreds of millions in response to natural-language queries such as "a fintech founder in Berlin who worked in payments." The deployed relevance policy is bottleneck-oriented: every active non-negotiable facet must be satisfied, and a pre-existing LLM Graded Relevance (GR) judge operationalizes this through a fixed min/median aggregation over facet grades. Cosine similarity instead averages evidence, letting a strong match on one facet mask failure on another, capping the recall of the first-stage (L0) retriever.   We present a policy-aligned retrieval framework: embeddings are partitioned into eight category-supervised segments whose scores follow the same min/median rule at serving time; for multi-vector retrieval, this segment score is computed independently per tagged document slot and maximized across slots. translated_title: 面向语义搜索的高效GPU检索
translated_abstract: LinkedIn 上的语义搜索需要从数亿规模的语料库中检索相关的人才档案，以响应诸如“在柏林从事过支付业务的金融科技创始人”这样的自然语言查询。已部署的相关性策略是面向瓶颈的：每一个活跃的、不可协商的维度都必须被满足，而现有的 LLM 分级相关性（GR）评判器通过对各维度评分采用固定的最小值/中位数聚合来实现这一策略。相比之下，余弦相似度是对证据取平均，这会让某个维度上的强匹配掩盖另一个维度上的失败，从而限制了第一阶段（L0）检索器的召回率。我们提出了一种与策略对齐的检索框架：将嵌入划分为八个类别监督的片段，这些片段在服务阶段的评分遵循相同的最小值/中位数规则；对于多向量检索，每个被标记的文档槽位独立计算该片段评分，并在所有槽位上取最大值。一个轻量级的单槽位第一阶段评分器生成……
tldr: LinkedIn 提出了一种与业务相关性策略（最小值/中位数聚合规则）对齐的 GPU 检索框架，通过将嵌入划分为八个类别监督片段并在多向量检索中按槽位独立评分取最大值，克服了余弦相似度取平均导致召回率受限的问题，实现了对数亿级人才档案的高效语义搜索。
en_tdlr: LinkedIn presents a policy-aligned GPU retrieval framework that partitions embeddings into eight category-supervised segments following the same min/median aggregation rule as the deployed relevance policy, with per-slot scoring maximized for multi-vector retrieval, overcoming cosine similarity's evidence-averaging limitation to enable efficient semantic search over hundreds of millions of profiles.
